description: Sony PlayStation P.E.Op.S. Soft GPU plugin with the xBRZ upscaling filter for PSEmu Pro compatible emulators
notes: This is a 32-bit GPU plugin DLL, not a standalone emulator.
Copy the files from $dir\plugins into your emulator's plugins folder (e.g. ePSXe), configure "P.E.Op.S. Soft Driver" and select xBRZ for stretching.
ePSXe 2.0 and later include xBRZ in its built-in GPU core.
This plugin is no longer developed.
